full_judgment:
According to plaintiffs’ case, the suit land along with other lands of the Suit khatian originally belonged to Moharaja Jagadindra Nath Roy and accordingly in the settlement Khatian No. 2 his name rightly appeared. The Moharaja had been in possession when plaintiffs’ predecessor one Md. Ismail Hossain took pattan of 10.60 acres of land out of 841.05 acres in BS Plot No. 1751 under BS Khatian No.1 of Mouza Chunea, PS Madhupur, District Tangail on the 15th of Magh, 1338 BS by paying proper Nazarana Selami and since then possessed the same till his death and after his death the plaintiffs received the same and during the last RS operation the suit land has been wrongly recorded in the name of the Collector instead of the plaintiffs or their predecessor and the plaintiffs first came to know the wrong record on 2.8.1987 when they went to the local Tehsil office to pay rent. That record in the name of the Collector created a cloud in the title of the plaintiffs and, as such, they were compelled to take recourse to the civil Court to remove the cloud from their title and also to have a declaration to that effect 

 3. The defendant Government appeared and contested the suit by filing written statement and categorically denied all the material allegations made in the plaint. Their material defence case is that after acquisition of Zamindarship the suit land vested in the Government and, as such, during the last RS operation it has rightly been recorded in the mime of the Collector in Khatian No.1 and also by Gazette notification dated 18.4.52 and 5.9.65 and the suit land vested in the Forest Department and as such the plaintiffs' suit is liable to be dismissed.
